title: [Auto Hide Cursor] Pointer stays hidden while an elevated (admin) window is in the foreground

judgment.rationale: Use the existing draft recovery/crosshair work rather than a competing proposal. Its changed visibility/input-observation boundaries match the reported scenario, but the open PR is not proof of a released or independently reproduced fix.
evidence: The author supplies normal/elevated controls, hook-versus-cursor-position observations and elevation/disable workarounds.
Newer comments refine the pre-hidden Alt+Tab transition, Task Manager and Windows Hello cases.
The old proposal saying no linked recovery PR is now stale: #51547 is linked and open.
Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/modules/MouseUtils/AutoHideCursor/AutoHideCursorWorker.cpp: Visibility is driven by hook input and timer cursor polling.
Read #51547's current changed-file list and worker patch; it includes state tests, visibility tests, crosshair visibility code and recovery behavior. Head db70f546ec94 is open, draft and unmerged.
judgment.recommended_action: Use the linked existing owner/fix; do not start a competing change.
